'''Yannick Lapointe TYPE II-Petite tarte au pacane-LS cannot lose''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19141">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19141 TYPE II-Petite tarte au pacane-LS cannot lose], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 28 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19141/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19141/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017015012/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19141/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
* '''Published:''' 28 September 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''TYPE II-Petite tarte au pacane-LS cannot lose''
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif|label=The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Podrace Prep|Tat-L-podraceprep.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor THGG Lapointe LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits the 6 destiny that recycle only once: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' use the power of Pacane to c0ck slap maul
